identity.title: Verify Line, Length, and Mean degenerate-input finite-result contract

origin.summary: 2D-033 requires a focused contract for Line/LineDistance/Mean normal values, polarity, empty or uniform inputs, no-edge and degenerate geometry, explicit units, and finite-result acceptance.

state.current_summary: 2D-033 Line/Length/Mean degenerate-input and finite-result semantics are verified through the existing LineGauge, LineDistance, Mean, metric-enrichment, acceptance, overlay, and Runner owners; LineDistance now rejects zero/non-finite distances with an explicit existing failure reason and no new metrology module was added.

objective.summary: Prove that Line/LineDistance and Mean publish finite, unit-explicit results for valid input and fail closed with an explicit reason for empty ROI, uniform/no-edge, zero-length, parallel, or coincident geometry instead of accepting NaN or Infinity.
constraints: Reuse the existing LineGauge, VisionPipelineLineDistanceTool, VisionPipelineLineIntersectionTool, MeanTool, metric enrichment, acceptance, overlay, and Run History owners.
Do not add a new metrology module, correction algorithm, alternate measurement calculation, or relaxed rerun.
Use deterministic synthetic fixtures and write test evidence only under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev.
Do not touch Original, release, deploy, hardware, or external systems.

criteria.text: Normal LineDistance and Mean fixtures produce finite published metrics, preserve declared pixel/mm or gray-value units, retain expected overlays, and keep positive/negative polarity or Mean type meaning explicit.

Empty input/ROI, uniform or no-edge input, zero-length or parallel/coincident geometry, and failed detection do not publish NaN or Infinity as an accepted measurement; they return the existing failure or explicit non-measurement reason.
Focused Debug/Release contract and documentation record the existing owner, call path, mutable metric/result writers, finite-result boundary, and unverified WPF/render/DPI/monitor/hardware limits.

evidence.observation: Debug contract passed normal LineDistance with finite DistancePx/DistanceMm metrics and overlays, inverted-source opposite polarity, normal Mean finite MeanValueMin/Max/Avg, uniform dark Mean acceptance rejection, empty Mean input/ROI validation, uniform/no-edge LineDistance failure, and coincident same-line failure with a positive-finite geometry reason and no non-finite metrics.
Release contract passed with the same normal, polarity, Mean, empty-input/ROI, no-edge, same-line, finite-metric, and explicit-failure observations as Debug.
Focused Debug and Release expected-failure (8/8), Preview/Run/Reopen (Mean, Blob, Contour, Matching, Line), and PixelPerMm finite-unit (5/5) contracts all exited 0 after the LineDistance guard.

Documentation records the current owner/call path, the positive-finite LineDistance boundary, finite Mean/acceptance semantics, unverified WPF/render/DPI/monitor/hardware boundary, PL-0091 closure, and next 2D-034 priority.

events.summary: Close 2D-033 as a bounded core/Runner contract slice: keep the existing LineGauge/LineDistance/Mean owners, filter LineDistance to positive finite distances before metric aggregation, preserve existing pixel/mm and Mean acceptance semantics, and leave WPF/runtime/hardware qualification outside this slice.
All PL-0091 criteria have active Debug/Release contract, focused regression, and durable documentation evidence; WPF/runtime/hardware qualification remains explicitly outside this slice.
